shortDescription: Pull images for use by podman

options.name: arch
options.description: CPU architecture for the container image

options.name: auth_file
options.description: Path to file containing authorization credentials to the remote registry.

options.name: build
options.description: Arguments that control image build.

options.name: ca_cert_dir
options.description: Path to directory containing TLS certificates and keys to use.

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to C(podman) executable if it is not in the C($PATH) on the machine running C(podman).

options.name: force
options.description: Whether or not to force push or pull an image. When building, force the build even if the image already exists.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the image to pull, push, or delete. It may contain a tag using the format C(image:tag).

options.name: password
options.description: Password to use when authenticating to remote registries.

options.name: path
options.description: Path to the build context directory.

options.name: platform
options.description: Platform for the container image (e.g. C(linux/amd64), C(linux/arm64)). Specify the platform for selecting the image when pulling or building. Mutually exclusive with C(arch).

options.name: pull
options.description: Whether or not to pull the image.

options.name: pull_extra_args
options.description: Extra arguments to pass to the pull command.

options.name: push
options.description: Whether or not to push an image.

options.name: push_args
options.description: Arguments that control pushing images.

options.name: quadlet_dir
options.description: Path to the directory to write quadlet file in. By default, it will be set as C(/etc/containers/systemd/) for root user, C(~/.config/containers/systemd/) for non-root users.

options.name: quadlet_file_mode
options.description: The permissions of the quadlet file. The O(quadlet_file_mode) can be specified as octal numbers or as a symbolic mode (for example, V(u+rwx) or V(u=rw,g=r,o=r)). For octal numbers format, you must either add a leading zero so that Ansible's YAML parser knows it is an octal number (like V(0644) or V(01777)) or quote it (like V('644') or V('1777')) so Ansible receives a string and can do its own conversion from string into number. options.name: quadlet_filename
options.description: Name of quadlet file to write. By default it takes image name without prefixes and tags.

options.name: quadlet_options
options.description: Options for the quadlet file. Provide missing in usual network args options as a list of lines to add.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether an image should be present, absent, or built.

options.name: tag
options.description: Tag of the image to pull, push, or delete.

options.name: username
options.description: username to use when authenticating to remote registries.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Require HTTPS and validate certificates when pulling or pushing. Also used during build if a pull or push is necessary.
